name: Kuula
positioning: A virtual tour publishing platform built around a large public community of 360° content, with a chromeless mode built for MLS compliance.
description: Kuula is a platform for uploading 360° panoramas and arranging them into virtual tours, with a public sharing community alongside paid tiers for custom branding, private/unlisted tours and a chromeless player with no Kuula branding or links.
real_estate_use: An agent or a photographer serving agents uploads 360° property photos, builds a connected tour with hotspots and floor plans, and shares it in a chromeless player with no visible branding or outbound links — a mode built specifically to meet MLS rules that forbid third-party branding on a listing tour.
features: Floor plans and Google Maps integration

use_cases.job: Publish an MLS-compliant virtual tour with no third-party branding or outbound links
